tools.name: proof_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a public http(s) URL and return a proof receipt: fetched_at, status_code, final_url, title, cleaned markdown, content SHA-256. Public URLs only; SSRF-guarded. Failures are not billable.

tools.name: read_clean
tools.description: Fetch a public URL and return only title + cleaned markdown (lighter than proof_fetch). SSRF-guarded.

tools.name: url_watch
tools.description: Fetch a public URL and return content_sha256 plus changed vs optional previous_sha256 (for monitor agents).

tools.name: site_crawl
tools.description: Polite same-origin crawl of a public site (robots.txt honored; sitemap.xml first, else shallow link BFS). Returns per-page {url, status, title, text_markdown, content_sha256, fetched_at}, totals, and a crawl-level sha256. SSRF-guarded. $0.002/page (min $0.01); failures not billable.

tools.name: sec_section
tools.description: Extract one Item section (e.g. 1A Risk Factors, 7 MD&A, 1 Business) from a company's latest (or Nth) SEC 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K or S-1 as markdown, with filing metadata (company, CIK, accession, filing date, URL) and content SHA-256. Public SEC EDGAR only. $0.02/section; failures not billable.
